verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents a Memory Export feature producing structured, schema-based exports of memories (mem0-docs-12/32), a CLI that can list/export/delete memories (mem0-docs-14/34, mem0-probe-rt-1), and a fully self-hostable open-source stack where 'you own the stack, the data, and every component' (mem0-docs-4/21/22). Together these give a user a path to pull out their data and run independently, but there's no explicit documentation of a one-shot 'export everything' bulk operation, no stated open standard format (just Pydantic/JSON schemas), and no independent/hands-on confirmation of a full data export-and-leave workflow. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk/full-account export endpoint, confirmation of a widely recognized open format (e.g., plain JSON/CSV dump of all memories), and independent verification of the export feature in practice.
